recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy black and white portrait of a figure in denim, obscured by shadow and overlaid with large, horizontally distorted glitch typography centered on the torso.
coreVisualRelationships: Heavy film grain unifying the background and subject
High-contrast lighting separating the figure from the void-like background
Horizontal digital distortion vs. organic fabric folds
coreInvariants: Horizontal pixel-stretch glitch effect on text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A human figure angled diagonally from the top-center toward the bottom-right, occupying roughly 60% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bright white glitched text centered horizontally and vertically.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the high-contrast text, follow the diagonal line of the figure's back upward to the head, then down the arm.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep, textured black space surrounding the figure, particularly dominant on the left and top.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays (denim texture and skin highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value contrast between the text and the background.

letterConstructionRules: Jagged, stepped edges on the left and right sides of glyphs
Internal texture matching the image grain
characterSpecificRedesigns: Glyphs are sliced into horizontal segments and offset laterally
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single impactful display face to maintain minimalist intensity.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight for the glitch effect to be legible.
Pre-distorted options that mimic the pixel-stretch look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a grainy, black and white, low-key photo of a person wearing an oversized denim jacket, standing at a diagonal angle against a pitch-black background. The lighting should be harsh, coming from the side to highlight the denim texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, bold sans-serif text in the center. Use a 'wind' or 'pixel sort' filter to stretch the edges of the letters horizontally. Add a heavy grain layer over the entire composition to blend the text into the image.

verificationChecks: Is the grain consistent across the black background and the white text?
Does the horizontal distortion look like a digital glitch?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Unique jewelry or brand logos on clothing
postGenerationChecks: Check for any color artifacts in the grain
Ensure the text distortion doesn't make it unreadable
Verify the background is sufficiently dark and void-like
Confirm the denim texture is sharp despite the grain
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-grain monochrome portrait with a centered, horizontally-glitched bold sans-serif display font for a gritty, modern aesthetic.
